name: ANL-24C-20MeV
description: ANL-23C extended by one 10–20 MeV group. The lower cutoff remains 5.0434766257 eV because the qualifying IRENA fast-spectrum coverage tally has zero reaction rate below it.
source: Derived from bundled ANL-23C by adding a 20 MeV upper boundary before the existing 10 MeV boundary.
